definitionZh: 溢出- rap CSS 属性适用于文本, 设定浏览器是否应在一个无法断开的字符串中插入换行符, 以防止文本溢出其行框 。
sourceDefinition: The overflow-wrap CSS property applies to text, setting whether the browser should insert line breaks within an otherwise unbreakable string to prevent text from overflowing its line box.
